statement: Kirchberg's $`\mathcal O_2`$ norm-ultrapower embedding problem. Constructs an explicit separable unital full group C∗-algebra that cannot embed unitally into the norm ultrapower of any fixed nonzero unital nuclear C∗-algebra, for any free ultrafilter on the natural numbers. Taking the target to be $`\mathcal O_2`$ answers Kirchberg's norm-ultrapower embedding problem negatively.
